applicability.rationale: Time-bound keyboard game with interruption, feedback and terminal states; model scope is the changed offline engine.

transitions.name: submit
transitions.guard: Playing and valid input before deadline

transitions.name: tick
transitions.effect: count down, advance feedback or finish

transitions.name: escape
transitions.effect: BrainFlow Menu / launcher Games without network

actors.name: device-loop
actors.ownership: single serialized owner; keyboard and clock are inputs

synthetic.name: four-game physical transition smoke
synthetic.criteria: User-confirmed install; each game, right/wrong response, pause, launcher, voice; no reset or leaked input
synthetic.rollback: Restore saved previous OTA manifest; no forced device downgrade

natural.name: four normal full rounds with interruption
natural.criteria: One completed round per game, responsive keys, preserved settings and healthy voice after play
